content.description: Goja JavaScript kodi. Mavjud vars/context/private va xavfsiz DB, HTTP, Telegram helper API'laridan foydalanadi; nomli branch uchun exit(name) ishlating.

aiDoc: JavaScript kod ishga tushirish (Goja VM). Kod data.jsCode da saqlanadi (engine va UI shu kalitni o'qiydi). MongoDB/HTTP async API mavjud. data.outputs=[{name}] e'lon qilinsa, exit('name') bilan `output-{name}` source handle orqali tarmoqlanadi. data.terminal=true — node leaf (o'zi javob yuborib oqimni tugatadi), keyingi edge yo'qligi normal (validator 'dead-end' ogohlantirishini o'chiradi). State/context'dan O'QISH uchun obyekt-access AFZAL: vars.<key> (ochiq, public_ ga map; state.<key> — legacy alias, hali ishlaydi) va private.<key> (maxfiy), context.<key> (xom kalit) — masalan vars.user_phone, context.first_name. jsCode'ni TOZA, ko'p qatorli yoz (engine verbatim saqlaydi) — docs_guide(topic='custom_code'). TELEGRAM API: tg_call(method, params) — xom Telegram Bot API chaqiruvi (masalan tg_call('createChatInviteLink', {chat_id: '@kanal', member_limit: 1}) → {ok, result}). Nomli wrapper'lar ham bor: send_message, send_photo, send_video, send_document, send_invoice, create_chat_invite_link, forward_message, edit_message_text, delete_message, answer_callback_query va h.k. TO'LOV: create_payment_link(amount, comment?, paymentType?) va payment_status(order_id). MUHIM: 'telegram.api' / 'bot.api' kabi obyekt YO'Q — Telegram uchun DOIM tg_call yoki nomli wrapper ishlat.

aiDoc: LLM agent node. Bitta provider sub-node (acc:ai_model portiga) va ixtiyoriy tool sub-node'lar (acc:ai_tool portiga) ulanadi. systemPrompt + userInputSource → LLM tool-calling loop → natija outputKey context o'zgaruvchisiga yoziladi (standart: agent_output). Keyingi nodelar {{agent_output}} orqali foydalanadi. Bog'lash: flow.connect(source=<provider_id>, source_handle='source-default', target=<agent_id>, target_handle='acc:ai_model'). Tavsiya: OpenAI yoki Ollama provider'i bilan boshlang. SUHBAT XOTIRASI: chatbot / suhbatdosh / savdo-agent uchun historyKey='{{chat_id}}' qoldir — engine har chat uchun dialogni alohida eslaydi. historyKey bo'sh bo'lsa agent stateless ishlaydi. TOOL ISHLAT: agent shunchaki matn yozmasin — real ma'lumot/harakat kerak bo'lsa acc:ai_tool'ga tool ula. Tool'siz agent uydirma javob berishi mumkin. TOOL TANLASH YO'RIQNOMASI: • dinamik DB ma'lumoti (katalog, buyurtma, foydalanuvchi) o'qish/yozish → AICollectionToolNode (read uchun operations=['read']); • tashqi REST API chaqirish → AIHTTPToolNode (natija status-aware: model 4xx/5xx xatoni ko'radi); • murakkab mantiq/hisob-kitob yoki bir nechta amal birga → AICustomCodeToolNode (kuchli — Mongo yoz, Telegram yubor, http; ehtiyot bo'l); • hujjat/bilim bazasi bo'yicha semantic (RAG) qidiruv → AIKnowledgeToolNode, LEKIN faqat tashqi Qdrant URL + embedding kaliti aniq mavjud bo'lsa (built-in vector DB YO'Q; aks holda tool jimgina tushib qoladi — o'rniga collection/http ishlat). Masalan 'narxni ayt' → AICollectionToolNode (real katalog), 'buyurtma yarat' → collection create yoki custom_code; • joriy sana/vaqt yoki sana hisobi (bron/jadval/eslatma) → AIDateTimeToolNode (credential YO'Q); • Google Sheet o'qish/yozish (lookup, log, buyurtma jurnali) → AIGoogleSheetsToolNode (type_key='google_sheets' OAuth credential, dashboard'da Connect with Google); • AI dinamik to'lov havolasi yaratsin (sotuv-agent narx aytib hisob chiqarsin) → AIPaymentLinkToolNode (paymentType click|paycue — qurishdan oldin SO'RA, payme YO'Q; maxAmount build-time injection-guard); • AI to'lov BUYURTMASI holatini tekshirsin (paid/pending/failed; 'to'ladim' deganda tasdiq) → AIPaymentStatusToolNode (order_id runtime arg, konfiguratsiya/credential YO'Q); STRUCTURED JSON: agent JSON qaytarishi kerak bo'lsa systemPrompt'da 'JSON qaytar' DEMA (ishonchsiz) — optional `jsonSchema` maydonini qo'shib schema string yoz; alohida switch yo'q va bo'sh bo'lmagan schema structured output'ni avtomatik yoqadi. Engine model'ni provider darajasida shu schema'ga majburlaydi va parse qilingan obyektni outputKey'ga yozadi ({{agent_output.field}}). Faqat schema'siz erkin matn kerak bo'lsa returnMode='json' (best-effort parse). XATO SEMANTIKASI (engine): SUCCESS bo'lsa errorOutputKey TOZALANADI (oldingi xato qoldig'i qolmaydi); provider XATO bersa outputKey bo'sh, errorOutputKey saqlanadi va flow KEYINGI node'ga DAVOM etadi (graceful) — shuning uchun errorOutputKey ustidan IfConditionNode bilan branch qilib xato holatini alohida ko'rsatish mumkin.

aiDoc: Collection tool sub-node. AIAgentNode'ning acc:ai_tool portiga ulanadi. tool='collection'. TEMPLATE (gibrid) model — har node BITTA `operation` (create|read|update|delete). read+create kerak bo'lsa BIR agentga ikki alohida collection tool ulang (har biri bitta operation). Sen (builder) so'rov SKELETINI sozlaysan, har field uchun FIXED yoki AI-SLOT tanlaysan; runtime AI faqat ai-slot'larni to'ldiradi. operation='read'/'update'/'delete' → filterMatch ('and'|'or') + filterConditions:[{field, op, source:'fixed'|'ai', value?|aiDescription?}]; op ∈ eq|ne|gt|gte|lt|lte|in|nin|contains|exists. operation='create' → documentFields:[{field, source, value?|aiDescription?}]. operation='update' → YANA changeFields (SET qilinadigan maydonlar; filterConditions QAYSI hujjat ekanini tanlaydi). source='fixed' → SEN `value` belgilaysan (constant yoki {{chat_id}}/{{<key>}}/{{user_id}}/{{username}} placeholder; saqlangan qiymat uchun {{<key>}} ishlatiladi va engine runtime'da resolve qiladi, BUTUN-placeholder XOM tipni saqlaydi: value="{{chat_id}}" int qoladi). FIXED slot'ni runtime AI O'ZGARTIROLMAYDI — shuning uchun user_id="{{chat_id}}" qilib tool'ni JORIY foydalanuvchiga xavfsiz biriktir. source='ai' → `value` bo'sh, `aiDescription` yoz; runtime AI shu tavsifga qarab qiymatni to'ldiradi. MISOL read: operation='read', filterMatch='and', filterConditions=[{field:'user_id', op:'eq', source:'fixed', value:'{{chat_id}}'},{field:'status', op:'eq', source:'ai', aiDescription:'qaysi holatdagi qarzlar (masalan active)'}]. MISOL create: operation='create', documentFields=[{field:'user_id', source:'fixed', value:'{{chat_id}}'},{field:'amount', source:'ai', aiDescription:'qarz summasi'},{field:'text', source:'ai', aiDescription:'qarz izohi'}]. content.label: Qatorlar o'zgaruvchisi (rows)
content.helpText: Toza qatorlar (array-of-objects) shu context kalitiga saqlanadi. Default: <responseVariable>_rows. Xabarda {{#each shu_kalit}}{{ustun_nomi}}{{/each}} bilan ishlatiladi.

aiDoc: Google Sheets (v4) — oauth2 credential orqali. credential_id type_key 'google_sheets' bo'lgan credential'ga ishora qiladi (secret flow'da emas, engine runtime'da access_token'ga aylantiradi). operation: append/read/update/clear. spreadsheet_id majburiy. range to'liq 'Sheet1!A1:C10' yoki sheet alohida berilsa faqat 'A1:C10' (engine sheet+range birlashtiradi) — sheet yoki range'dan kamida biri bo'lishi shart. values JSON 2D massiv (append/update). JAVOB SHAKLI (read): context[responseVariable] (default 'sheets_response') = XOM Google API javobi {majorDimension, range, values} — values 2D massiv, 1-QATOR SARLAVHA, qolganlari ma'lumot; bu OBYEKT, {{#each}} bilan ISHLAMAYDI. Engine yana context[rowsVariable] (default '<responseVariable>_rows' = 'sheets_response_rows') ga TOZA array-of-objects yozadi (sarlavha qatori kalit): [{ustun_nomi: qiymat}, ...]. Ro'yxatni xabarda chiqarish uchun ALBATTA rowsVariable'ni ishlat: `{{#each sheets_response_rows}}{{ustun_nomi}}{{/each}}` — XOM responseVariable'ni {{#each}} bilan ISHLATMA. Yana context[responseVariable+'_status'], context['sheets_success'] ham yoziladi. READ FILTER (in-memory, STATIK — AI-slot YO'Q): faqat ayrim qatorlar kerak bo'lsa filterConditions bilan rowsni field/op/value bo'yicha filterla, filterMatch ('and'|'or', default 'and') ularni birlashtiradi. op ∈ eq|ne|gt|gte|lt|lte|in|nin|contains|exists; field — ustun nomi (1-qator sarlavhasi); value'da {{chat_id}}/{{<key>}} (saqlangan ochiq qiymat — {{<key>}}) ishlaydi (masalan price>100000 yoki category=={{category}}). Filterlangan natija ham rowsVariable'ga yoziladi. CREDENTIAL: qurishdan OLDIN credentials.list(type_key='google_sheets'); yo'q bo'lsa credentials.connect_oauth(type_key='google_sheets') bilan ULASH linkini ber (OAuth — API orqali yaratib BO'LMAYDI); ulangach qayta list qilib credential_id ol.

Google Drive (v3) — oauth2 credential orqali. credential_id type_key 'google_drive' bo'lgan credential'ga ishora qiladi. operation: list/create_folder/upload/delete. list uchun query (Drive q filtri); create_folder/upload uchun file_name; folder_id ota-papka; upload uchun content (matn) + mime_type (default 'text/plain'); delete uchun file_id. Natija context[responseVariable] (default 'drive_response'), _status, context['drive_success'] ga yoziladi. CREDENTIAL: qurishdan OLDIN credentials.list(type_key='google_drive'); yo'q bo'lsa credentials.connect_oauth(type_key='google_drive') bilan ULASH linkini ber (OAuth — API orqali yaratib BO'LMAYDI); ulangach qayta list qilib credential_id ol.
